description: Shield Slam deals 50% more damage. Normal mana and global cooldown apply.
Gain an absorb ward equal to 20% of maximum health for Rampage's duration. Does not replace or stack with an active ward.
Guardian Roar protection lasts 50% longer; taunt is still a one-time threat boost.
Smoke Bomb refreshes Tripwire. Normal mana and cooldowns apply.
This Fireball deals +100% damage to slowed or control-immune targets. Does not bypass control immunity.
Arcane Missiles launches five missiles instead of three. Normal mana and cooldown apply.
Activates boosted Spirit Guardians damage and radius.
Guardian Embrace also protects the caster from damage for 3s base. Does not make allies immune.
Radiant Strike deals 100% more damage. No enemy mark required.
Healing Light heals living nearby allies around you (base 20-unit radius). Does not resurrect.
